verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸਤਗੀਰ ਹੁਇ ਪੰਜ ਪੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਤੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhasatageer hui pa(n)j peer har gur har gobi(n)dh atolaa|

en.bdb: The first five Gurus held the hands of the people and the sixth Guru Hargobind is incomparable God-Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਦਾ ਪਾਤਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਸਾਹ ਅਡੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: dheen dhunee dhaa paatasaeh paatasaahaa(n) paatasaeh addolaa|

en.bdb: He is the king of spirituality as well as temporality and is in fact irremovable emperor of all the kings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਿ ਹੁਇ ਮਸਤਾਨ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)j piaale ajar jar hui masataan sujaan vicholaa|

en.bdb: Assimilating the unbearable knowledge of the earlier five cups (Gurus) in the inner core of his mind he re,mains merry and wise mediator for humanity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਰੀਆ ਚੜੑਹਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਪਰਮਤਤੁ ਛਿਅ ਵਰਤਾਰੇ ਕੋਲੋ ਕੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: tureeaa chaR(h)h jin paramatat chhia varataare kolo kolaa|

en.bdb: In spite of the six philosophies spread around, he reaching the turiyä (highest stage of meditation) has attained the supreme reality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਛਿਅ ਪੀੜ੍ਹੀਆਂ ਇਕਸੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: chhia dharasan chhia peeRheeaa(n) ikas dharasan a(n)dhar golaa|

en.bdb: He has strung all the six philosophies and their sects in the strung of one philosophy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਵਿਰੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: jatee satee sa(n)tokheeaa(n) sidh naath avataar virolaa|

en.bdb: He has churned the essence of the lives of celebate ascetics, the followers of truth, contented people, the siddhs and naths (yogis) and the (so called) incarnations of God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਸੁਮੰਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਤਨ ਅਮੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: giaareh rudhr suma(n)dhr vich mar jeeve tis ratan amolaa|

en.bdb: All the eleven Rudrs remain in the ocean but those (divers) who seek life in death get the invaluable jewels.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਸੋਲਾਂ ਮੇਲ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਹਿੰਡੋਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: baareh solaa(n) mel kar veeh ikeeh chaRhaau hi(n)ddolaa|

en.bdb: All the twelve zodiac sings of sun, sixteen phases of moon and numerous constellations have provided a beautiful swing for him.
This Guru is omniscient yet he possesses a childlike innocence.
